name: Riversong the Elder
summary: During the Lunar Festival, pilgrims seek Riversong the Elder beneath a shrine in Astranaar. The night elf spirit offers wisdom and points them toward other honored ancestors across Kalimdor.

sections.title: A Beacon in Astranaar
sections.body: In Astranaar, Riversong the Elder waits beneath an open night elf shrine. A shaft of light falls through the Ashenvale canopy onto her spirit. During the Lunar Festival, pilgrims gather there to honor those who came before.

sections.title: Gazing at the Heavens
sections.body: Riversong the Elder recalls how night elves read truth and mystery in the stars. She urges patience and contemplation, then guides pilgrims toward other spirits, including Elder Starweave.

faq.q: Where can I find Elder Riversong?
faq.answer: You can find Riversong the Elder beneath a small night elf shrine in Astranaar, Ashenvale. A beam of light falls through the forest canopy onto her.

faq.q: What is the purpose of visiting Elder Riversong?
faq.answer: Pilgrims honor Riversong the Elder during the Lunar Festival to pay respect to their ancestors. She grants an ancestral blessing and coins of ancestry, and guides them toward other elders across Kalimdor.

faq.q: Which elder does Riversong direct you toward?
faq.answer: Riversong the Elder directs you toward Elder Starweave, another honored night elf spirit observing the festival.

faq.q: Can Horde players speak to Elder Riversong?
faq.answer: You can speak with Riversong the Elder as a Horde traveler, though Astranaar's guards and sentinels stand in your way. Festival elders do not refuse communion based on faction.

faq.q: Why is Elder Riversong surrounded by a beam of light?
faq.answer: The beam of light around Riversong the Elder represents the favor of Elune and the heavens. It illuminates each ancestral spirit who appears during the Lunar Festival.

faq.q: What does Elder Riversong say when honored?
faq.answer: Riversong the Elder speaks of the countless stars and the answers they hold to earthly mysteries. She asks whether the wise and lucky might gaze upward and find truth.

angles.text: As a night elf, you can honor Riversong the Elder beneath an Astranaar shrine, joining your people's long history beneath Ashenvale's stars.
As an Alliance pilgrim, you can visit Riversong the Elder easily in Astranaar, one of the Alliance's primary strongholds in central Kalimdor.
As a druid, you can see the Lunar Festival's celestial elders as part of the ancient Cenarion bond with nature, spirits, and the night sky.
